gaps.desktop: Inside the open card the loser greys out all its text: the title is about #242424 against the winner's #151515, and the notes and checklist items are about #3b3b3b against the winner's #2d2d2d. The list rows outside the card are the same darkness in both, so in the loser the item being edited reads paler and less important than the list around it. Set the card title to the same near-black as the list rows (#1a1a1a or darker) and the notes and checklist to about #2d2d2d, as the winner does.
gaps.phone: The loser draws its notes and checklist text lighter (about #2b2b2b at the darkest, against the winner's #1b1b1b) and tracks them slightly looser (the first notes line runs about 2px wider). The three checklist rows are the main editable content, and they come out washed-out grey next to the black 20pt title. Use the winner's near-black 17pt text with tighter native tracking for the notes and checklist.

why: Layout, spacing, card shadow, hairlines and icons match to the pixel; the winner's card text is darker and crisper, while the loser's notes and checklist fade toward grey.
